title: Data Analysis
text:
Running Code
When you click the Render button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

1 + 1

[1] 2

library(tidyverse)

data <- read.csv("chart.csv")

You can add options to executable code like this

test <- ggplot(data = data, (mapping = aes(x = Date, y = Bitcoin))) +
  geom_smooth() + 
  labs(title = "Bitcoin cost increase since 2014 to 2025")

test

`geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'









The echo: false opti on disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
